user.title: Create Occupancy Helper
user.description: Combine multiple motion, presence, or contact sensors into a unified occupancy entity with configurable logic, hold time, linked timer entity, and dynamic state icons.

data_description.sensors: Select binary sensors (presence, motion, door contact) or boolean helpers.
data_description.delay_off: Keep the room marked as occupied for this duration after all sensors have turned off.
data_description.timer_entity: Optional linked helper: Select a 'timer.*' entity to start a visual countdown when sensors clear (room turns off when timer finishes), or an 'input_number.*' entity for dynamic delay duration.
data_description.active_icon: Icon shown when room is occupied (e.g., mdi:bed or mdi:motion-sensor).
data_description.idle_icon: Icon shown when room is clear (e.g., mdi:bed-empty or mdi:motion-sensor-off).

error.empty_sensors: Please select at least one sensor.
